metadata.case_name: LEE SAU FAT v. F. H. SECURITY SERVICES COMPANY LIMITED

injuries.description: On 7th May 2005, whilst on duty she slipped and fell from a stool and injured her right wrist and loin (“1st Accident”).
source: On 7th May 2005, whilst on duty she slipped and fell from a stool and injured her right wrist and loin (“1st Accident”).
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

injuries.description: On 15th February 2006, she sustained right knee injury in a slip and fall accident as she hurried to report for duty with complaint of right ankle pain the following day (“2nd Accident”).
source: On 15th February 2006, she sustained right knee injury in a slip and fall accident as she hurried to report for duty with complaint of right ankle pain the following day (“2nd Accident”).
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg, unspecified

injuries.description: On 17th March 2006, whilst on duty she twisted her right leg when walking downstairs from the 16th to 17th floor (“3rd Accident”).
source: On 17th March 2006, whilst on duty she twisted her right leg when walking downstairs from the 16th to 17th floor (“3rd Accident”).
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of other or unspecified parts of knee

injuries.description: Dr Lam diagnosed Madam Lee’s orthopaedic injuries to be soft tissue injury to both knees and right ankle, which he opined were consistent with the mechanism of injury described "and …… likely to be caused by the subject accident".
source: Dr Lam diagnosed Madam Lee’s orthopaedic injuries to be soft tissue injury to both knees and right ankle, which he opined were consistent with the mechanism of injury described "and …… likely to be caused by the subject accident".
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

injuries.description: the picture from the arthroscopy was one of degenerative arthritis of the right knee which was pre-existing
source: the picture from the arthroscopy was one of degenerative arthritis of the right knee which was pre-existing
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg
